The '''Schism Collective''' was an organization active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and successive [[Galactic War]]. It was constituted mostly by brilliant [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] technological savants and led by [[Arkis Wode]]. Their experiments were condemned as dangerous or even barbaric by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] observers.<ref name="TOR" />

Eventually the Schism Collective's skills drew the attention of [[Darth Malgus]], who patiently earned its members' trust with gifts of technology and test subjects. The Schism repayed him with valuable scientific achievements such as incorporating the technology of the ancient [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] into the [[Tenebrae|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|captured space station]]. They also augmented the weaponry used by Malgus's [[New Empire|forces]] with [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] devices and perfecting the production of Malgus' stealth [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="TOR" />
